questions.expl: ：他们也用它来放松他们的空闲时间。 they 他们；them 他们；their 他们的；themselves 他们自己。their 是形容词性物主代词，修饰名词 free time。故选C。
：但他们中的一些人没有以正确的方式使用它。 in 在……里；on 在……上面；at 在(时刻)；of…的。in a right way“用一种正确的方式”。故选A。

：制定与父母一起使用互联网的规则，例如，你什么时候可以上网，可以上网多久，可以 做什么活动。 because 因为；when 什么时候；after 之后；until 直到。根据“...you can go online, for how long and what activities you can do online.”可知，你什么时候可以上网，可以上网多久，可以做什么活动。这是三 个疑问，所以选择疑问词when。故选B。
：不要把你的密码给别人，也不要把以下信息给别人——你的真实姓名、家庭地址、年龄、 学校电话号码或其他重要信息。 someone 某人；anyone 任何人；everyone 每人；no one 没有人。根据“Don’t give your password to... else”可知，不要把密码给任何人。故选B。

：不要把你的密码给别人，也不要把以下信息给别人——你的真实姓名、家庭地址、年龄、 学校电话号码或其他重要信息。 or 或者；before 之前；so 所以；but 但是。根据“your real name, home address, age, school phone number... other important information.”可知，你的真实姓名、家庭地址、年龄、学校电话号码或其 他重要信息。故选A。
：在发放信用卡号码之前，请与父母核实。 give 动词原形；gave 动词过去式；to give 动词不定式；giving 动名词。before doing“在做某事之前”。 故选D。
：如果你认为自己不合适，千万不要用电子邮件把自己的照片发给别人。 a 一个；an 一个；this 这个；/零冠词。根据“Never send... photo of yourself to someone in e-mail”可 知，绝不用电子邮件把自己的照片发给别人。此处泛指“一张”，用不定冠词a/an，且photo 发音是 以辅音音素开头，填a。故选A。
：在你进入聊天室之前先和你的父母聊一聊。 Check 动词原形；To check 动词不定式；Checking 动名词；Checked 动词过去式。根据“Check with your parents...”和“Never send...”可知，该句也是祈使句，用动词原形开头。故选A。
：你和你的父母必须确保这是一个适合你的地方。 may 可能；can 可以；must 必须；might 可能。根据“You and your parents... make sure it’s a right place for you.”可知，父母必须确保这个地方适合你。故选C。
：未经父母允许，千万不要同意与你在网上认识的人见面。 meet 动词原形；meeting 动名词；met 动词过去式；to meet 动词不定式。agree to do“同意做某事”。 故选D。
：记住安全第一。 safe 安全的，形容词；safely 安全地，副词；safety 安全，名词；save 救，动词。remember 后是宾 语从句，从句缺少主语，名词safety 可以作主语。故选C。
：所以你应该比平时更仔细。 much careful 表达错误；more careful 更仔细，比较级；the most careful 最仔细，最高级；careful 仔 细的，原级。由than 可知，用比较级。故选B。
：不要轻易相信别人。 easy 容易的，形容词；easily 轻易地，副词；easier 更容易，形容词的比较级；the easiest 最容易， 形容词的最高级。用副词修饰动词believe in others。故选B。

：如果你在网上看到或读到的东西让你感到不舒服，请离开网站。 make 动词原形；made 动词过去式；making 动名词；makes 动词第三人称单数形式。“you see or read online”修饰“something”，所以if 从句的主语是something，if 引导的条件状语从句符合“主将从现” 的时态规则，即从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时。something 是第三人称单数，所以动词用 第三人称单数形式。故选D。
：你想别人怎样对待你就怎样对待别人。 other 其他，后加名词；the other 其他，后加名词；others 其他(人)，后不能加名词；another 另一 个，后加单数名词。空格后没有名词，填others“别人”。故选C。
：互联网极大地改变了我们的生活。 changed 改变；created 创造；developed 发展；decreased 减少。根据“The Internet has... our lives greatly” 可知，互联网改变了我们的生活。故选A。
：互联网帮助了我们很多，我们几乎能够在不走出房间的情况下做所有事情。 by 通过；without 没有；with 有；also 也。根据“The Internet helps us a lot and we can do almost everything... going out of the room”可知，互联网可以帮助我们在不走出房间的情况下做所有的事情。 故选B。
：例如，如果我们计划去很远的地方看朋友，我们可以给他发电子邮件，告诉他我们的旅 行。 from 从；behind 后面；with 有；away 向远处。far away“在远处”，固定短语。故选D。
：我们也可以在家里通过网上购物买一些礼物。 working 工作；stopping 停止；shopping 购物；staying 待在。根据“We can also buy some presents”可 知，应该是在网上购买礼物。故选C。
：当然，如果我们最终不能去，我们可以上网取消门票和礼物。 presents 礼物；books 书；clothes 衣服；food 食物。根据“We can buy train tickets or air tickets online. We can also buy some presents”可知，我们也可以取消网上购买的票和礼物。故选A。
：我们可以在互联网上搜索有用的信息。
：如今，越来越多的学校开设了在线课程，学生可以随时登录网页学习。 learn 学习；watch 观看；play 玩；write 写。根据“Nowadays more and more schools have online classes and students can log onto their web pages”可知，学生登录网页学习。故选A。
：有些人整天晚上都在网上冲浪，这对他们的健康不利。 get 得到；spend 花费；use 使用；take 拿。根据“Some people... whole days and nights surfing online” 可知，花费时间网上冲浪，用spend。故选B。
：一些青少年对网络游戏感兴趣，这对他们的学习不利。 interested 感兴趣的；nervous 紧张的；terrible 糟糕的；creative 有创造力的。根据“Some teenagers are... in online games”可知，对网络游戏感兴趣，be interested in“对……感兴趣”。故选A。
：我们应该正确使用互联网，然后互联网会让我们的生活变得更好。 quietly 安静地；properly 正确地；exactly 准确地；gently 温和地。根据“We should use the Internet” 可知，应该正确使用互联网。故选B。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “They” refer to?
Which of the following can summarize Paragraph Four?
opts: AI will replace all human jobs.
AI is helpful in healthcare and education.
AI is helpful but not perfect and needs wise use.
AI can build a better future for humans.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“Although AI can do many things, it’s not perfect. Some people worry that it might take all jobs, like factory work or customer service.”及通读全段可知，虽然AI 能做很多事，但是它并 不完美，并需要理智的使用。故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the structure of the passage? (P1: Paragraph 1; P2: Paragraph 2...)
questions.expl: 结构题。通读全文可知，第一段引出话题，即探索AI 是如何帮助我们的；第二段和第三 段具体从两个方面讲了AI 是如何帮助我们的；第四段指出虽然AI 能做很多事，但是它并不完美； 第五段进行总结和呼吁。故选A。

questions.stem: Where can we read the passage?
questions.expl: 判断题。通读全文可知，文章主要介绍AI 是如何帮助我们的及呼吁我们理智的使用它， 可能出现在科学杂志上。故选D。

questions.stem: What’s the best title for the passage?
opts: AI: a powerful tool for our lives
How to make an AI software
A tool which may replace humans
questions.expl: 标题题。通读全文可知，文章主要介绍AI 这一有力工具在生活中是如何帮助我们的。故 选A。 B Summer is coming quickly. It’s the time of the year in which people like to change their clothes for the new season. But how about adding something high-tech (高科技的) to the summer look? Let’s check out some of the ways in which technology (技术) is changing the clothes people wear. A Chinese research team has developed 3D printing techniques that can create clothes with the ability to change temperatures. The technology they used is those materials that change with the environment. The team placed an object in the clothing that could be transformed (转换). It also absorbs (吸收) or gives off heat depending on the wearer’s body temperature. Zhang Yongyi, a Chinese Academy of Sciences researcher, said it was the first time such clothing had been made using a controllable 3D printing method. Scientists in South Korea have developed a kind of wearable clothes that create electricity (电) as wearers keep moving. Of course, it doesn’t take much time or effort for people. Wearers only need to move naturally to power small electronic objects. The inside of the clothes produces energy, which is then stored. Although the clothes have an electronic object built in, they feel completely normal. Kim Sang-Woo, a professor at the Sungkyunkwan University, is proud of his team’s development, saying, “It feels like a normal jacket.” In another amazing study, clothes could serve as devices (设备) themselves. A team of engineering students from the University of Washington, the US, have led these efforts by putting a special thing into cotton T-shirts. The clothing can then send the message that can be received by cellphones. 31．What is the main idea of the text? A．Advice on choosing clothes. B．High-tech changes in clothing. C．The history of 3D printing. D．Famous scientists in technology. 32．What can the Chinese 3D-printed clothes do? A．Change colors. B．Send messages. C．Store energy. D．Control temperature. 33．Why are the South Korean clothes special? A．They make power. B．They feel heavy. C．They use cotton. D．They change shape. 34．What is the structure(结构) of the passage? (P-Paragraph) A． B． C． D．

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the text?
What can the Chinese 3D-printed clothes do?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“A Chinese research team has developed 3D printing techniques that can create clothes with the ability to change temperatures.”可知，中国的3D 打印服装可以控制温度。故选D。

questions.stem: Why are the South Korean clothes special?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Scientists in South Korea have developed a kind of wearable clothes that create electricity (电) as wearers keep moving.”可知，韩国的衣服特别之处在于它们能发电。故选A。

questions.stem: What is the structure(结构) of the passage? (P-Paragraph)
questions.expl: 结构题。文章第一段总述科技改变服装，第二、三、四段分别介绍不同国家在服装科技方 面的研究，是总分结构。故选A。

questions.stem: In which section of a magazine (杂志) can you read the text?
questions.expl: 判断题。文章主要讲服装方面的科技，所以可能在杂志的科技板块读到。故选C。

questions.stem: How many questions should you ask yourself before you post a photo online?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Before you post a photo or video online, you should ask yourself:◆Is it against the law or rules?◆Will it make anyone feel uncomfortable?◆Could it affect your life?◆Would you be happy for your parents or friends to see it?”可知，一共提出了四个问题。故选B。

questions.stem: Which password does the writer advise to use according to the text?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Don’t use your name or anything easy to guess.”和“Use a mixture of capitals, numbers and special characters.”可知，不要使用自己的名字，密码应包含大写字母、数字和特殊字 符。故选C。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the text?
opts: You should only tell people the good bits online.
You can use either a nickname or your real name online.
You can tell your password to your best friend or parents.
You shouldn’t tell your phone numbers to anyone strange.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Only give your phone number to the people you actually know.”可知，不应该 把电话号码告诉陌生人。故选D。

questions.stem: What’s the main purpose of the text?
opts: To tell us to use the Internet in the right way.
To encourage us to learn something new online.
To explain the importance of using the Internet.
To give us some suggestions about staying safe online.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“For Internet Safety”并通读全文可知，文章从发布内容前的思考、密码设置、

questions.stem: In which part of a magazine can we read the text?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“For Internet Safety”并通读全文可知，文章围绕青少年上网安全给出建议， 属于青少年建议范畴。故选A。
